description: This file defines a 'Home' component for a note-taking frontend application using the Blits framework. It manages component composition, state synchronization with a store, and renders UI elements such as navigation, notes list, editor, and empty state.

classes.name: Home
classes.description: A Blits component representing the main page, managing note data and rendering child components such as navigation, note list, editor, and empty state.

methods.name: _sync
methods.description: Synchronizes the component's local state with the application's store, updating the notes count.
